summary: Globus Medical filed an 8-K reporting Q3 2026 results (Item 2.02) and disclosing that on November 2, 2026 its Board authorized a $500.0 million increase to the existing Class A common stock repurchase program (Item 8.01). Following the increase, roughly $611.0 million remained available. No price per share, premium, or expiration is stated; the program has no time limit and may be suspended or discontinued at any time. Repurchases may occur via open-market or privately negotiated transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18 plans, at management's discretion. Watch pace of buybacks versus free cash flow and any M&A redeployment; no arbitrage angle exists in an open-ended authorization.
